fields.name: date
fields.description: Meal date; ISO on most subjects, US MM/DD/YYYY on the time_of_day variant

fields.name: time
fields.description: Clock time; aliased from time_of_day on 4 subjects

fields.name: time_end
fields.description: Optional meal-end clock; absent on the headerless 11-col variant

fields.name: logged_food
fields.description: Food name as the participant typed it

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount, kept as text (mix of numbers and words such as 'quarter')

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of amount (fluid ounce, cup, gram, …)

fields.name: searched_food
fields.description: Matched database name, when the log found one

fields.name: sugar
fields.description: Sugar in grams; no unified column, recorded in annotations
